character_tex: Parafermion characters (string functions) $\Phi^l_m$ from $\chi^{SU(2)_k}_l(\tau,z) = \sum_{m\in\mathbb{Z}_{2k}}\Phi^l_m(\tau)\,\Theta_{m,k}(\tau,z)/\eta(\tau)$, fields $(l,m)\sim(k-l,m+k)$. On the $C$-fixed fields $(l,0)$, $l$ even, the twined characters are $t_l = (-1)^{l/2}\eta(2\tau)^{-1}\sum_{x\equiv l+1\ (2K)}\sin\frac{\pi x}{2}\,q^{x^2/4K}$, $K = k+2$, and $\Phi^{l,\pm}_0 = \frac12(\Phi^l_0\pm t_l)$. Twisted characters: $\mathcal{T}_y = \eta(\tau/2)^{-1}\sum_{n\in\mathbb{Z}}(-1)^n q^{(y+2Kn)^2/16K}$ ($y\equiv k$ mod 2, $0<y\le k$), of weight $h = \frac{k-2+y^2}{16K}$; $\mathcal{T}^{\pm}_y$ are its parts with $L_0-h$ in $\mathbb{Z}$ and $\mathbb{Z}+\frac12$. Here $k = 5$.
description: Orbifold of the diagonal $\mathbb{Z}_{5}$ parafermion theory by charge conjugation $C: \Phi^l_m\to\Phi^l_{-m}$ (Dijkgraaf-Vafa-Verlinde-Verlinde 1989). The untwisted sector keeps one copy of each pair $\{(l,m),(l,-m)\}$ and the $C$-even parts of the 3 fixed fields $(l,0)$; the twisted sector $Z_{C,1} = \sum_y|\mathcal{T}_y|^2$ is the Poisson resummation of $Z_{1,C} = \sum_l |t_l|^2$, projected to integer spin. Lightest twisted state: $h = \bar h = 1/28$.
